options.name: label
options.description: Metric name; names the card (group) and, by default, the trend sparkline. Non-empty.

options.name: value
options.description: A number (formatted with valueFormat or formatValue), preformatted text, or null ('No value').

options.name: previous
options.description: Previous value; the change is computed from it when value is a number (percent: (value - previous) / |previous|, not shown for 0; absolute: value - previous). Finite.

options.name: delta
options.description: Explicit change (a ratio for 'percent', units for 'absolute'); wins over previous. Finite.

options.name: comparisonLabel
options.description: Caption after the change, for example 'vs last month' (shown only with a change).

options.name: trend
options.description: Trend values rendered as a Sparkline (null is a gap); an empty array shows none.

options.name: trendLabel
options.description: Sparkline accessible label. Default: the card label.

options.name: trendColor
options.description: Chart palette slot of the sparkline (1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8; SparklineColor from @absoluteui/components/sparkline).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format of the value (and of an absolute change).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value formatter; wins over valueFormat (also used for an absolute change).

options.name: href
options.description: Make the whole card a link (http(s) or relative URLs only; others throw). The URL can change with update(), but adding or removing href throws.

options.name: busy
options.description: Show 'Loading' instead of the value (no change) and set aria-busy.

options.name: sentiment
options.description: Whether an increase is favorable, unfavorable, or neither; decides the color and the spoken 'favorable'/'unfavorable'.

options.name: deltaFormat
options.description: Relative change (percent, max 1 fraction digit) or the difference in value units.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: delta
properties.description: The change as displayed (ratio or units), or null.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Adding or removing href throws.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroy the sparkline, remove the rendering, the host class, and the configuration subscription.

cssClasses.name: aui-stat-card__body
cssClasses.description: Card root: a div (role=group) or, with href, an a element (also aui-stat-card__link).

cssClasses.name: aui-stat-card__change | __delta | __arrow | __comparison
cssClasses.description: Change row, change amount, arrow icon, comparison caption.

cssClasses.name: aui-stat-card__sr
cssClasses.description: Visually hidden spelled-out change for assistive technology.
